title: Aromatic Dense Slovakian Pork Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew featuring pork, pickle juice, and a blend of spices, perfect for satisfying midnight cravings. This dish is also anti-inflammatory friendly.
instructions: Heat a Korean brass bowl or a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the pork cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it starts to caramelize, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the pickle juice, yellow mustard, caraway seeds, and black pepper, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Add the cubed potatoes and continue to simmer, covered, for an additional 20 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or dill, if desired.
